evidence.reason: At the current tip the TimeoutExpired handler records exc.stdout/exc.stderr directly. On POSIX, CPython's TimeoutExpired carries joined byte buffers even when subprocess.run(text=True) is used, so a non-empty timed-out command stores bytes in ACTIONS. The later JSON serialization cannot encode bytes and the probe phase fails instead of recording the timeout. The proposed decode fixes an existing implementation error; no contract conflict.
